title: TSMC To Install First ASML Dual Wafer Stage Platform

passages.locator: Main text, opening and discussion of AT:750, AT:1100 and Fab 12
passages.note: Reports shipment of a production dual-stage AT:750 for TSMC Fab 12 and identifies the AT:1100 as a 193 nm ArF version of the dual-stage platform. The shipment details and product specifications are attributed to ASML.
